summary.request: Sales lines get a Handling Class. Warehouse staff must see it on picks created from warehouse shipments and on inventory picks at our basic-warehouse locations. It must stay on registered picks, posted inventory picks, warehouse entries and the item ledger entries of the shipment. Bin-to-bin internal movements also need a Move Reason that is kept on the registered inventory movement.
summary.business-process: Outbound warehouse handling of sales orders (warehouse picks from shipments and inventory picks), sales shipment posting, and bin-to-bin internal movements

data-flow.note: Entered on the sales order line; defaulting from master data is an open question.
OnBeforeCreateShptLineFromSalesLine on Sales Warehouse Mgt., before the line is inserted (no Modify).

data-flow.to: Warehouse Activity Line (pick: take, place and breakbulk lines)
data-flow.note: OnAfterTransferFromShptLine on Warehouse Activity Line, raised by Create Pick for every temporary line.
CreateRegActivLine in Whse.-Activity-Register; same field number and type required.
OnBeforeWhseJnlRegisterLine on Whse.-Activity-Register; only at Bin Mandatory locations, one per take or place line.
OnBeforeInsertWhseEntry on Whse. Jnl.-Register Line; covers every path that creates warehouse entries.
OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromSalesLine on Item Journal Line; runs for warehouse shipment posting and for inventory pick posting, both of which run Sales-Post.
OnAfterInitItemLedgEntry on Item Jnl.-Post Line, before the entry is inserted.

data-flow.from: Item Journal Line (warehouse shipment posting at a bin location)
data-flow.note: OnAfterCreateWhseJnlLine on WMS Management; item tracking splits copy the whole record.
Whse.-Activity-Post copies the activity line by TransferFields.

data-flow.from: Warehouse Activity Line (inventory pick posting at a bin location)
data-flow.note: CreateWhseJnlLine during inventory pick posting raises OnAfterCreateWhseJnlLine; confirm publisher and signature in symbols (see unresolved).

data-flow.to: Warehouse Activity Line (Invt. Movement, take and place lines)
data-flow.note: OnCreateInvtMvntWithoutSourceOnAfterTransferFields on Create Inventory Pick/Movement; CreatePickOrMoveLine inserts take and place lines from the same record. The internal movement line is deleted afterwards, so it cannot be read later.
Whse.-Activity-Register branches on activity type; inventory movements go to Registered Invt. Movement Line by TransferFields.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from Sales Line to the Warehouse Shipment Line before insert.
guards: Assign only; no Modify and no re-read of the sales line.

guards: Do not use OnBeforeWhseActivLineInsert on Create Pick: it does not pass the shipment line and misses breakbulk and place lines.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from the activity line to the warehouse journal line when a pick is registered.
guards: No Modify of registered lines or entries after registration.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from the warehouse journal line to the warehouse entry.
guards: Never patch warehouse entries after posting.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from the item journal line to the warehouse journal line during warehouse shipment posting at bin locations.
Copy Handling Class from the sales line to the item journal line.
Copy Handling Class from the item journal line to the new item ledger entry before insert.
guards: No source-document filter needed: other journal lines leave the field empty.
Never find and Modify item ledger entries after posting.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from the sales line to the inventory pick line.
guards: Do not use OnBeforeNewWhseActivLineInsertFromPurchase on this codeunit; it serves outbound purchase lines.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Handling Class from the inventory pick activity line to the warehouse journal line when an inventory pick is posted at a bin location.
guards: Confirm the publisher and signature in the target version before implementing.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Move Reason from the internal movement line to the inventory movement activity line.
guards: Do not read the internal movement during registration; it is deleted after the inventory movement is created.

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification on every new table-extension field (a table extension has no table-level value to inherit); choose the value that matches what Handling Class and Move Reason store, and resolve any ToBeClassified.

If Handling Class or Move Reason become code tables (open questions), plan each as a new entity: table type, list page, permission set composed from included sets, classification. Table extensions and subscriber codeunits alone need no new permission set entries.
No install or upgrade code: existing documents and entries keep an empty value. Confirm no backfill of open sales lines or existing entries is wanted.

knowledge.used-for: Pick creation from shipments, registration to Registered Whse. Activity Line and the registration hop to warehouse journal lines.
constraints: Same field number and type on Warehouse Activity Line and Registered Whse. Activity Line so registration copies it with no subscriber.
Copy on picks from shipments in OnAfterTransferFromShptLine on Warehouse Activity Line; it runs for every take, place and breakbulk line.
For warehouse entries, copy to the warehouse journal line in OnBeforeWhseJnlRegisterLine on Whse.-Activity-Register, then to the entry in OnBeforeInsertWhseEntry.
Do not use OnBeforeWhseActivLineInsert on Create Pick; do not find registered lines and Modify them.
Registration writes warehouse entries only at Bin Mandatory locations; pick worksheet and internal pick use other builders and events.

knowledge.used-for: Sales line to warehouse shipment line hop.
constraints: Add the field to the warehouse line with the same number and type as on the source line.
Copy in OnBeforeCreateShptLineFromSalesLine on Sales Warehouse Mgt., before insert.
Do not copy in OnAfterCreateShptLineFromSalesLine with Modify, nor re-read the source line in OnBeforeWhseShptLineInsert.
Other sources (returns, transfers) raise their own events; plan one subscriber per source type needed.

knowledge.used-for: Warehouse journal line and warehouse entry hops, including shipment posting at bin locations.
constraints: Add the field to Warehouse Journal Line and Warehouse Entry; copy in OnBeforeInsertWhseEntry on Whse. Jnl.-Register Line.
For document posting, put the value on the item journal line first, then copy it in OnAfterCreateWhseJnlLine on WMS Management.
For other paths such as registering a pick, confirm where the warehouse journal line is built; do not assume CreateWhseJnlLine.
Do not find warehouse entries after posting and Modify them.

knowledge.used-for: Inventory picks at basic-warehouse locations: creation, posted inventory pick lines, and item ledger entries via the source line.
constraints: The source line is the carrier for any value that must reach item ledger entries; the item journal line is built by sales posting, which never reads the activity line.
Copy to the inventory pick line in OnBeforeNewWhseActivLineInsertFromSales on Create Inventory Pick/Movement.
Same field number on Posted Invt. Pick Line so TransferFields copies it.
If users enter the value on the activity line, write it back in OnUpdateSourceDocumentOnBeforeModifySalesLine; several activity lines merge into one buffer line per source line.
At bin locations CreateWhseJnlLine builds warehouse entries from each activity line and raises OnAfterCreateWhseJnlLine.

knowledge.used-for: Move Reason on internal movements, inventory movement lines and Registered Invt. Movement Line.
constraints: Decide which movement documents the feature covers.
Same field number on Warehouse Activity Line and Registered Invt. Movement Line; registration copies by TransferFields.
Copy at creation in OnCreateInvtMvntWithoutSourceOnAfterTransferFields on Create Inventory Pick/Movement.
Do not extend only Registered Whse. Activity Line; inventory movements land in Registered Invt. Movement Line.
Do not read the internal movement during registration; it is usually deleted and not referenced by the activity line.

knowledge.used-for: Deciding which sales stages Handling Class must reach and which are left to the requester.
constraints: Decide which stages the field must reach before writing code and plan one step per stage.
Item ledger entry is reached by two subscribers through Item Journal Line.
Name page extensions, permission entries and a test that posts and reads the value back from every target.
Do not fill ledger entries after posting by finding and modifying them.

knowledge.used-for: Sales line to item journal line to item ledger entry.
constraints: Add the field to Item Journal Line and Item Ledger Entry; copy in OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromSalesLine and OnAfterInitItemLedgEntry.
Store the field on the ledger entry only when users must see or filter it as a native list column, or it is read on almost every access.
Other item journal postings leave the field empty; no source-document filter is needed.
Do not find item ledger entries after posting and Modify them.

knowledge.used-for: Mirrored Handling Class and Move Reason definitions across TransferFields targets.
constraints: Define mirrored fields with the exact same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade.
A shorter length on one side compiles but fails at runtime when a longer value is copied.

knowledge.used-for: Storage choice for Handling Class on Item Ledger Entry.
constraints: Prefer a related table keyed by Entry No. for optional, sparse or integration attributes.
Use a stored table-extension field only when the value must appear as a native list column and is read on almost every access.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltips for the new page fields.
constraints: On runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later define the tooltip on the table field and omit duplicate page-level tooltips.
On earlier runtimes add page-level tooltips.
Tooltip text must state what the value is for, without inventing behavior.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltip inheritance for bound page fields (applies from BC24 / runtime 13.0).
constraints: A bound page field inherits the source field's ToolTip when it declares none; do not add duplicates.
A field with neither an inline nor an inherited tooltip is a real gap.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures for locations, items, sales orders and warehouse documents.
constraints: Build fixtures with Library codeunits, not hand-rolled Init/Insert.
Create parents first and Validate foreign-key fields.

knowledge.used-for: Value type decision for Handling Class and Move Reason.
constraints: A fixed set of named, mutually exclusive choices is typed as Enum, not a raw Integer.

knowledge.used-for: DataClassification of the new table-extension fields.
constraints: Every Normal field a tableextension adds must set its own DataClassification.
Choose the classification that matches the data stored; ToBeClassified is not a safe default.

knowledge.used-for: Conditional: only if Handling Class or Move Reason become user-maintained code tables.
constraints: Plan table type, pages, permissions, classification, install and tests for a new record type.
A row the request does not settle is a question for the requester, not a default.

open-questions.question: Is Handling Class a fixed set of values (Enum) or a list users maintain (Code field with a TableRelation to a new Handling Class table)? What length if Code?
Is Move Reason a fixed set of values (Enum) or a user-maintained code table?
Is Move Reason entered per internal movement line or once on the Internal Movement header? The confirmed creation event passes the line.
Is Handling Class entered manually on each sales line, or defaulted from the item, customer or sales header?
May warehouse staff change Handling Class on a pick or inventory pick? If yes, must the change flow back to the sales line (and so to the item ledger) on inventory pick posting?
If Handling Class changes on the sales line after the warehouse shipment, pick or inventory pick exists, must the existing warehouse documents be updated?
Must Handling Class also reach posted sales shipment/invoice lines, sales line archives or posted warehouse shipment lines? These are not designed because the request does not name them.
Must users see or filter Handling Class as a native column on Item Ledger Entries? If not, a related table keyed by Entry No. is preferred over a stored field on this hot ledger.

Are movement-worksheet movements, pick-worksheet picks, internal picks, sales return orders or transfers in scope? Only internal movements, picks from warehouse shipments and inventory picks from sales lines are designed.
Must Move Reason also reach the warehouse entries written when an inventory movement is registered?

unresolved: bc-version, countries and application-area are not stated; tooltip inheritance applies only from BC24 (runtime 13.0).
